messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 - HelixP payments - txn API 5xx spike in eu-west-1. Error rate 28% over last 3m. impact: HelixP production.

paging-bot: Paging on-call: @maya.

maya: on it, grabbing logs. any customer-facing comms ready?

ryan.sre: I'm seeing a spike in 502s from the payments inference gateway. stack traces show TLS handshake drops to gateway behind lb. attaching recent tail: ```[2025-10-07 14:01:22] pay-gw eu-west-1 502 backend read error: conn reset by peer
[2025-10-07 14:02:05] pay-gw eu-west-1 200 ok but latency 800ms
[2025-10-07 14:03:10] cache miss rate +12%```

jamie-cs: HelixP is high-touch; account expects a proactive update. Leah, do we have their primary contacts?

leah-am: yes - HelixP contacts (do not publish publicly):
- Priya Kaur (Head of Integrations) priya.kaur@helixp.com, +44 7700 000111
- Marco Silva (SRE Lead) marco.silva@helixp.com, +44 7700 000222
- Legal: Emma Chen legal@helixp.com, +44 7700 000333

jamie-cs: thanks. I'll draft a quick concise note for HelixP — want to confirm impact window.

ryan.sre: mitigation step 1: temporarily route HelixP traffic to backup axis in eu-central-1, same model variant. I can flip routing if traffic volume allows.

maya: approved, go ahead when ready.

ryan.sre: executing route change now: ```/bin/rw-route switch --customer helixp --from eu-west-1 --to eu-central-1 --weight 100```

deploy-bot: Command accepted, routing change started.

statusbot: Routing change observed, tailing metrics.

maya: monitoring infra and token-level latency. initial improvement in error rate to 6% after route.

paging-bot: next: customer notification draft below — internal review pls.

jamie-cs: paste below and I'll adjust tone. ```Hi Priya,
We're investigating elevated 5xx errors affecting HelixP's payments API in eu-west-1. We've rerouted your traffic to eu-central-1 as a temporary mitigation which has reduced errors. Our engineers are continuing root-cause analysis and will follow up with a post-incident summary. Estimated affected window: 14:00–14:15 UTC. We're treating this as P1 and will keep you updated every 30 minutes. — Jamie (Redwood Customer Success)```

oliver-legal: quick note — avoid admitting data exposure. Keep to availability and impact.

leah-am: acknowledged.

jamie-cs: sending to Priya/Marco now.

jamie-cs: sent to Priya and Marco, subject: 'Service incident - payments API — mitigation in place'

maya: just to capture internal comms: short status page update for public customers (non-sensitive): ```Status: Partial outage (payments API) Region: eu-west-1 Impact: Elevated error rates for payment-related endpoints. Mitigation: Traffic routed to eu-central-1 for affected customers. ETA for full resolution: investigating.```

ryan.sre: internal post for SRE channels — include steps we ran and next actions: ```- 14:01 detect 5xx spike
- 14:05 verified gateway TLS handshake errors
- 14:07 rerouted HelixP traffic to eu-central-1
- 14:12 error rate dropped from 28% -> 6%
- next: collect core dumps from pay-gw-2, escalate to infra for LB healthcheck rolling restart, plan full rollback when fixes merged
```

jamie-cs: HelixP replied: "Thanks for the quick update. Please inform our legal team too."

oliver-legal: looped in Emma (legal) and keep logs/timeframes for compliance.

maya: on-call handoff note for night shift: if residual errors >5% after 60m escalate to @ryan.sre and page infra leads.

leah-am: customer follow-up template for account teams (short): ```HelixP update: We mitigated elevated errors by routing your traffic to eu-central-1. Our engineers are investigating root cause; we'll provide a post-mortem within 48 hours. If you need immediate assistance call Priya/Marco or reply to this thread.```

jamie-cs: SLM (Service Level Manager) — please log customer impact in CS tracker: Impacted txns estimated ~0.7% of daily volume during window.

statusbot: Public status page updated (Partial outage) and sent update to subscribers.

paging-bot: All hands check: do we need to spin up dedicated capacity for HelixP?

maya: not yet, err rates are acceptable on backup; keep option open.

ryan.sre: created incident ticket INC-20251007-helixp with runbook link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-20251007-helixp

maya: adding final checklist: - collect logs + core dumps - LB healthcheck + restart - verify no config drift - prepare postmortem draft

jamie-cs: I'm drafting customer-facing post-incident email (short) — dropping it here for legal review: ```Subject: Incident report — Payments API Partial Outage (eu-west-1)
Body:
Hello Priya,

At ~14:00 UTC on 2025-10-07 we observed elevated 5xx errors affecting payments endpoints in eu-west-1 that impacted HelixP. We mitigated the issue by routing your traffic to eu-central-1 which reduced the error rate. We are continuing root-cause analysis and will share a full post-incident report within 48 hours. No customer data was accessed or changed as a result of this incident.

Sincerely,
Jamie, Redwood Customer Success
```

oliver-legal: change "No customer data was accessed" to "We have no evidence of data access at this time" — keep it cautious.

jamie-cs: updated wording and sending.

maya: last note — handoff at 17:00 UTC to night oncall @sami; include incident ticket and current mitigation in handoff.

ryan.sre: leaving logs and commands used in the ticket.

jamie-cs: closing thread for now — will reopen if impact returns. :white_check_mark:
